faq.q: What song plays when Jason picks up Andrés de León in GTA 6?
faq.a: "Se Me Nota (Agarrame)," a 2021 dembow collaboration by Chimbala and Omega, plays there. It runs from roughly 20:07 to 21:32 in the Netflix Extended Look, as Jason gets into a car after picking up Andrés de León from an airport runway.

faq.q: Who performs Se Me Nota (Agarrame) in GTA 6?
faq.a: Chimbala and Omega. Their dembow collaboration released on April 23, 2021, and was documented by GameRant with a timestamp from the GTA VI Netflix Extended Look.

faq.q: What genre is Se Me Nota (Agarrame)?
faq.a: Dembow. The record describes it as a 2021 collaboration between Chimbala and Omega, heard as Jason picks up Andrés de León from an airport runway.

faq.a: He is a character Jason picks up from an airport runway during this song. The record does not give further detail about him beyond this scene.
